title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1988-09-23
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-8 (no Dolby) > Audiophile 2496 analog > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-XG 90's, no Dolby. Mics on stand in OTS

ai_review.summary: Good sound quality (especially after an EQ tweak) paired with a solid, well‑executed show.
ai_review.review: The recording is generally clear and enjoyable, though listeners note that a modest EQ adjustment improves it further. The performance itself is described as very good – steady and well‑done, but not a "smoker" or standout night.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review; it rates the show 4/5 overall and mentions a good recording that benefits from EQ tweaking, indicating a solid but not exceptional performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear enough for enjoyment; reviewers suggest an EQ tweak improves clarity, implying no major flaws but some room for tonal balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistent and solid throughout; the show is described as well‑done but not a smoking performance.
